dedupe_keys.name: samsung lithium ion battery broadband impedance by state of charge

description: This deposit contains broadband electrochemical impedance measurements for four new Samsung ICR18650-26J lithium-ion cells. The University of Perugia collaborators provide six repetitions at each of ten states of charge, from ten to one hundred percent, across fourteen frequencies from 0.05 to 1,000 hertz. CSV files link complex impedance values to measurement, battery, state-of-charge and frequency identifiers, giving 3,360 impedance values. Mendeley Data provides free CC BY 4.0 access. Coverage is limited to a laboratory sample of one cell model, not a geographic fleet or ageing time series. The repository explicitly says these measurements are absent from an earlier linked dataset, so the earlier deposit is not assumed to be a duplicate. A reviewer-assessed use is fitting or testing equivalent-circuit and electrochemical components in storage simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related project-level battery model. No impedance fit or cell-level data analysis was performed.
